name: infaris/monitoring
description: Guard by Infaris App Monitoring for PHP: requests per route, cache hit/miss, database queries, errors, logs and traces for Shopware, Symfony, Laravel, WordPress and plain PHP.

suggest.ext-curl: Faster and more reliable delivery; falls back to PHP streams without it.
suggest.ext-opentelemetry: With open-telemetry/opentelemetry-auto-pdo, every PDO query (also in Shopware) joins the request trace.
